text: レッドは　しょくぶつポケモン　フシギダネが　いいんじゃな？

structure.jp: しょくぶつポケモン　フシギダネが　いいんじゃな？
structure.en: want the Plant Pokémon Bulbasaur, right?

patterns.name: 〜がいい
patterns.span: フシギダネが　いい
patterns.explanation: A thing plus がいい means 'that is the one I want'. フシギダネが　いい = 'Bulbasaur is the one you want'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ gives a tone of checking or explaining; んじゃ is the old-man form, and な asks for agreement. いいんじゃな = 'so that's the one you want, is it?'.
